CHAPTER ONE: GENERAL
PROVISIONS

articles.heading: Icyo iri tegeko rigamije Iri tegeko rigenga ikoreshwa ry’umuhanda hagamijwe gukumira impanuka zo mu
articles.text: muhanda.

articles.heading: Isobanura Muri iri tegeko
articles.text:
(a) “ikinyabiziga” bivuga ikintu cyose
gikoreshwa mu gutwara abantu cyangwa
ibintu mu muhanda cyangwa igikoresho
cyose gihabwa imbaraga kugira ngo
kigende mu muhanda;
(b) “impanuka yo mu muhanda” bivuga
impanuka itagambiriwe kandi
itunguranye ibereye mu muhanda,
ihuriyemo ikinyabiziga kimwe cyangwa
byinshi bigenda, bigateza umuntu
ibikomere, ihungabana, ubumuga
cyangwa urupfu, cyangwa bigateza
kwangirika k’umutungo;
(c) “impanuka yo mu muhanda
yapfiriyemo umuntu” bivuga impanuka
yabereye mu muhanda kandi
yapfiriyemo nibura umuntu umwe ikiba
cyangwa agapfa mu gihe cy’iminsi 30
ibarwa uhereye ku munsi yabereyeho;
(d) “Minisitiri” bivuga Minisitiri ufite
ikoreshwa ry’umuhanda mu nshingano;
(e) “umugenzacyaha” bivuga umukozi
w’urwego rufite kurinda umutekano wo
mu muhanda mu nshingano ushinzwe
kugenza ibyaha byerekeye ikoreshwa
ry’umuhanda;
(f) “umuhanda” bivuga –
(i) inzira imwe cyangwa nyinshi
zigendwamo n’ibinyabiziga
zitandukanyijwe ku buryo
bugaragara n’ubutaka, ubusumbane
cyangwa umurongo urombereje;
(ii) aho ibinyabiziga bishobora
guhagarikwa;
(iii) ibiraro;
(iv) cyangwa inzira n’utuyira.
(g) “umukozi ubifitiye ububasha” bivuga
umupolisi uri mu kazi ko kubungabunga
umutekano wo mu muhanda;
(h) “umuntu” bivuga umuntu ku giti cye,
isosiyete y’ubucuruzi, amakoperative,
ikigo cyangwa urundi rwego rufite
ubuzimagatozi;
(i) “umuyobozi ubifitiye ububasha”
bivuga umwofisiye w’ishami ry’urwego
rufite kurinda umutekano wo mu
muhanda mu nshingano, umuyobozi wa
Polisi y’u Rwanda ku rwego rwa
sitasiyo, ku rw’Akarere cyangwa ku
rw’Intara n’abayobozi babo;
(j) “umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga” bivuga
umuntu utwaye ikinyabiziga mu
muhanda.

articles.heading: Ibirebwa n’iri tegeko Iri tegeko rireba ikoreshwa ry’umuhanda
articles.text:
Icyakora, ntirireba inzira ikozwe mu byuma,
mu nsinga cyangwa indi nzira yihariye.
UMUTWE WA II: UBURYO BWO
KUGENDA MU MUHANDA
N’UMUTEKANO WO MU MUHANDA
Icyiciro cya mbere: Uburyo bwo kugenda
mu muhanda

articles.heading: Uruhande rugenderwamo n’ikinyabiziga
Ibyubahirizwa mu ikoreshwa ry’umuhanda (1) Ibyubahirizwa mu ikoreshwa ry’umuhanda harimo –
articles.text:
(a) uburyo abanyamaguru,
ibinyabiziga, inyamaswa zikurura,
izikorera ibintu, izo bagenderaho
n’amatungo bigenda mu muhanda;
(b) inshingano z’ugenda mu muhanda
igihe habaye impanuka yo mu
muhanda;
(c) inshingano z’ugenda mu muhanda
ategetswe n’umukozi ubifitiye
ububasha;
(d) imiterere y’ikinyabiziga isabwa
mu rwego rwa tekiniki;
(e) uko ikinyabiziga gipakirwa;
(f) uburyo n’igihe isuzuma
ry’ibinyabiziga rikorwamo
hakurikijwe ibyiciro byabyo;
(g) ibimenyetso bigenga ikoreshwa
ry’umuhanda;
(h) n’ibiranga ikinyabiziga.
(2) Iteka rya Minisitiri rigena mu buryo
burambuye ibyubahirizwa byerekeye
ikoreshwa ry’umuhanda.
Icyiciro cya 2: Umutekano wo mu muhanda
Akiciro ka mbere: Ububasha bwo
kugenzura ikoreshwa ry’umuhanda
n’ibyifashishwa mu kuwurinda

articles.heading: Ububasha bwo kugenzura ikoreshwa ry’umuhanda (1) Ububasha bwo kugenzura ikoreshwa ry’umuhanda bufitwe
articles.text:
n’umugenzacyaha cyangwa umukozi
ubifitiye ububasha.
(2) Umugenzacyaha cyangwa umukozi
ubifitiye ububasha atanga amabwiriza
agamije kubungabunga umutekano wo
mu muhanda.
(3) Amabwiriza atanzwe
n’umugenzacyaha cyangwa umukozi
ubifitiye ububasha asimbura muri uwo
mwanya ibimenyetso bigenga
ikoreshwa ry’umuhanda.

articles.heading: Ibikoresho n’ikoranabuhanga byifashishwa n’urwego rufite kurinda umutekano wo mu muhanda mu nshingano
articles.text:
(1) Urwego rufite kurinda umutekano wo
mu muhanda mu nshingano
rwifashisha ibikoresho byabugenewe
n’ikoranabuhanga ryerekeye amakuru
y’umutekano wo mu muhanda.
(2) Iteka rya Minisitiri rigena imiterere
n’imikoreshereze by’ibikoresho
n’ikoranabuhanga byifashishwa
n’urwego rufite kurinda umutekano
wo mu muhanda mu nshingano.

articles.heading: Impuzankano y’umukozi ubifitiye ububasha (1) Umukozi ubifitiye ububasha yambara impuzankano yabugenewe
articles.text:
(2) Urwego rufite kurinda umutekano wo
mu muhanda mu nshingano rugena
impuzankano y’umukozi ubifitiye
ububasha.
Akiciro ka 2: Gupima arukoro mu maraso
no gupima mu mubiri ibiyobyabwenge
cyangwa urusobe rw’imiti ikoreshwa nka
byo

articles.heading: Igipimo ntarengwa cya arukoro mu maraso ku muyobozi w’ikinyabiziga (1) Igipimo ntarengwa cya arukoro mu
articles.text:
maraso ku muyobozi w’ikinyabiziga ni
garama 0.80 muri litiro imwe y’amaraso.
(2) Iteka rya Minisitiri rishobora kugabanya
igipimo cya arukoro mu maraso kivugwa
mu gika cya (1).

articles.heading: Uburyo bwo gupima arukoro mu maraso no gupima mu mubiri ibiyobyabwenge cyangwa urusobe rw’imiti
articles.text:
ikoreshwa nka byo
(1) Umugenzacyaha cyangwa umukozi
ubifitiye ububasha apima cyangwa
agategeka umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga
gupimwa arukoro mu maraso no gupima
mu mubiri ibiyobyabwenge cyangwa
urusobe rw’imiti ikoreshwa nka byo
hifashishijwe ibikoresho byabugenewe
igihe cyose bibaye ngombwa hagamijwe
kubungabunga umutekano wo mu
muhanda.
(2) Iyo umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga atemeye
ibyagaragajwe n’ipimwa ry’igipimo cya
arukoro mu maraso no gupima mu mubiri
ibiyobyabwenge cyangwa urusobe
rw’imiti ikoreshwa nka byo yakorewe,
ashobora gusaba ko ipimwa rikorwa na
laboratwari yemewe.
(3) Iteka rya Minisitiri rigena laboratwari
zemerewe gupima arukoro mu maraso no
gupima mu mubiri ibiyobyabwenge
cyangwa urusobe rw’imiti ikora nka byo
n’uburyo iryo pimwa rikorwa ku
muyobozi w’ikinyabiziga.
Akiciro ka 3: Kubuza ikinyabiziga kugenda
no kukirekura

articles.heading: Kubuza ikinyabiziga kugenda (1) Kubuza ikinyabiziga kugenda bikorwa hashingiwe ku mabwiriza umuyobozi
articles.text:
wacyo ahabwa n’umugenzacyaha
cyangwa umukozi ubifitiye ububasha yo
kugumisha ikinyabiziga aho kiri cyangwa
hafi yaho, ariko amategeko yerekeye
guhagarara umwanya munini agakomeza
kubahirizwa, hagamijwe kubungabunga
umutekano wo mu muhanda cyangwa
kugenza ibyaha biwuhungabanya.
(2) Kubuza ikinyabiziga kugenda bimara igihe
kitarenze amasaha 12 abarwa uhereye
igihe ikinyabiziga cyaburijwe kugenda.

articles.heading: Impamvu zo kubuza ikinyabiziga kugenda (1) Umugenzacyaha cyangwa umukozi ubifitiye ububasha abuza ikinyabiziga kiri
articles.text:
mu muhanda kugenda iyo –
(a) umuyobozi wacyo atagira uruhushya
rwo kugitwara rwemewe;
(b) ikinyabiziga cyangwa ibyo gitwaye
byangiza umuhanda cyangwa
ibiwukikije;
(c) ikinyabiziga, umuyobozi wacyo
cyangwa undi muntu ukirimo
bibangamira ikoreshwa ry’umuhanda
cyangwa bituma ikoreshwa
ry’umuhanda ryatera amakuba kubera
kujugunya mu muhanda,
kuwurundamo, kuwurekeramo,
kuwunyanyagizamo ibintu ibyo ari byo
byose cyangwa kuwushyiramo
inkomyi iyo ari yo yose;
(d) kivuburira mu muhanda imyotsi
cyangwa imyuka ihumanya ikirere,
birenze igipimo cyagenwe
n’amategeko abigenga;
(e) ibyagishyizweho kugira ngo
kidasakuza cyane byahinduwe ukundi
cyangwa byavanyweho;
(f) kidafite ibyapa cyangwa gifite ibyapa
bitemewe n’amategeko;
(g) kitakorewe isuzuma ritegetswe
ry’imiterere tekiniki cyangwa ibyo
gukorwaho cyangwa gutunganywaho
byategetswe n’iryo suzuma bitakozwe;
(h) gitwaye abantu mu buryo bwa rusange
kitabifitiye uruhushya;
(i) kidafite ubwishingizi;
(j) gishakishwa;
(k) gitwaye ibirenze ibyo kigomba
gutwara;
(l) umuyobozi wacyo afite ubumuga
butamwemerera gutwara ikinyabiziga;
(m)cyangwa gifite inenge z’imiterere
tekiniki zabangamira umutekano wo
mu muhanda.
(2) Iteka rya Minisitiri rigena inenge
z’imiterere tekiniki y’ikinyabiziga
zabangamira umutekano wo mu
muhanda.

articles.heading: Imicungire y’ikinyabiziga cyabujijwe kugenda (1) Iyo ikinyabiziga cyabujijwe kugenda, umugenzacyaha cyangwa umukozi
articles.text:
ubifitiye ububasha ategeka ko gishyirwa
ahemewe hafi y’aho cyari
cyahagaritswe.
(2) Iyo kubuza ikinyabiziga kugenda
byatewe n’impamvu ivugwa mu ngingo
ya 12(1)(a)(l), ikinyabiziga gishobora
kwemererwa gukomeza urugendo iyo
habonetse undi muyobozi
w’ikinyabiziga ufite uruhushya rwo
kugitwara ushyizweho n’uwari ugitwaye
cyangwa na nyiracyo.
(3) Iyo kubuza ikinyabiziga kugenda
byatewe n’impamvu ivugwa mu ngingo
ya 12(1)(k), umugenzacyaha cyangwa
umukozi ubifitiye ububasha ashobora
gutegeka umuyobozi wacyo kugishyira
ku munzani kugira ngo gipimwe
cyangwa kugipima hakoreshejwe ubundi
buryo bwabugenewe. Iyo ikinyabiziga
kirengeje ibyo cyemerewe gutwara
hakurikizwa amategeko abigenga.
(4) Iyo kubuza ikinyabiziga kugenda
byatewe n’impamvu zivugwa mu ngingo
ya 12(1)(g) umugenzacyaha cyangwa
umukozi ubifitiye ububasha ntashobora
kukirekura kitagaragaje ko cyahawe
gahunda y’isuzuma.
(5) Iyo kubuza ikinyabiziga kugenda
byatewe n’impamvu zivugwa mu ngingo
ya 12(1)(m), umugenzacyaha cyangwa
umukozi ubifitiye ububasha ashobora
gutegeka ko kijyanwa aho kijya
gukosorerwa gikuruwe cyangwa
cyikorewe n’ikindi kinyabiziga
cyashyizweho n’umuyobozi wacyo
cyangwa na nyiracyo.
(6) Iyo impamvu yatumye ikinyabiziga
gihagarikwa ikiriho, umugenzacyaha
cyangwa umukozi ubifitiye ububasha,
mbere y’uko ava aho ikinyabiziga
cyahagaritswe, yuzuza ifishi
yabugenewe.
(7) Iyo impamvu yatumye ikinyabiziga
gihagarikwa itakiriho, umugenzacyaha,
umukozi ubifitiye ububasha cyangwa
umukuriye mu kazi yemerera
ikinyabiziga kugenda akuzuza ifishi
yabugenewe.

articles.heading: Guhitamo aho guhagarika ikinyabiziga Iyo kubuza ikinyabiziga kugenda bitewe n’impamvu ivugwa mu ngingo ya 12(1)(i)
articles.text:
cyangwa iyo impamvu yatumye kibuzwa
kugenda idashobora gukosorerwa aho kiri,
bisabwe n’umuyobozi wacyo cyangwa na
nyiracyo, ikinyabiziga gishobora guhagarikwa
ahantu yihitiyemo. Muri icyo gihe,
ikinyabiziga cyabujijwe kugenda gishobora
kujyanwa aho hantu ari uko gikuruwe
cyangwa cyikorewe n’ikindi kinyabiziga
cyashyizweho n’umuyobozi wacyo cyangwa
na nyiracyo.

articles.heading: Ifishi yo kubuza ikinyabiziga kugenda n’ifishi yo kurekura ikinyabiziga (1) Umugenzacyaha cyangwa umukozi
articles.text:
ubifitiye ububasha wafashe icyemezo cyo
kubuza ikinyabiziga kugenda cyangwa
kurekura ikinyabiziga yuzuza ifishi yo
kubuza ikinyabiziga kugenda n’iyo
kukirekura mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga
cyangwa akayuzuza mu nyandiko igihe
uburyo bw’ikoranabuhanga
budashoboka, bigahita bimenyeshwa
nyir’ikinyabiziga cyangwa umuyobozi
wacyo.
(2) Amabwiriza y’urwego rufite kurinda
umutekano wo mu muhanda mu
nshingano agena imiterere n’ibikubiye
mu ifishi ivugwa mu gika cya (1).

articles.heading: Gukura ikinyabiziga aho cyahagaritswe (1) Umugenzacyaha cyangwa umukozi ubifitiye ububasha yemerera umuyobozi
articles.text:
w’ikinyabiziga cyangwa nyiracyo
kugikura aho cyahagaritswe amaze
kugenzura ko impamvu yatumye
kubuzwa kugenda yavuyeho.
(2) Umugenzacyaha cyangwa umukozi
ubifitiye ububasha ategeka
nyir’ikinyabiziga cyangwa umuyobozi
wacyo kugikura aho bari bagihagaritse
no kukijyana aho ibinyabiziga
bifungirwa mu gihe icyatumye kibuzwa
kugenda kitakemutse.
(3) Iyo nyir’ikinyabiziga cyangwa
umuyobozi wacyo atagikuye aho
umugenzacyaha cyangwa umukozi
ubifitiye ububasha yagihagaritse ngo
akijyane aho ibinyabiziga bifungirwa,
urwego rufite kurinda umutekano wo mu
muhanda mu nshingano ni rwo
rukihajyana, nyiracyo akishyura ikiguzi
kijyanye n’icyo gikorwa.
Akiciro ka 4: Ifungwa ry’ikinyabiziga

articles.heading: Gufunga ikinyabiziga (1) Gufunga ikinyabiziga bikorwa hashingiwe ku cyemezo gifatwa n’umuyobozi ubifitiye ububasha cyo
articles.text:
gushyira ikinyabiziga ahantu
hateganyijwe ku mpamvu zo
kubungabunga umutekano wo mu
muhanda kugeza igihe ikinyabiziga
gishubijwe nyiracyo, kigurishijwe na
nyiracyo cyangwa gitejwe cyamunara.
(2) Umuyobozi ubifitiye ububasha ufunze
ikinyabiziga yuzuza ifishi yabugenewe yo
gufunga ikinyabiziga, agaha nyiracyo
cyangwa umuyobozi wacyo kopi yayo.
(3) Amabwiriza y’urwego rufite kurinda
umutekano wo mu muhanda mu
nshingano agena imiterere n’ibikubiye
mu ifishi yo gufunga ikinyabiziga.
(4) Gufunga ikinyabiziga bishobora
kubanzirizwa no kukibuza kugenda, mu
gihe umugenzacyaha cyangwa umukozi
ubifitiye ububasha asanga ari ngombwa
kandi hakurikijwe ibiteganywa n’iri
tegeko.

articles.heading: Impamvu zo gufunga ikinyabiziga Ikinyabiziga gifungwa iyo – (a) cyatawe cyangwa cyasizwe ku
articles.text:
muhanda cyangwa ku mpande zawo ku
buryo bubangamiye umutekano wo mu
muhanda kandi nyiracyo adashobora
kuboneka;
(b) nyiracyo cyangwa umuyobozi wacyo
atakemuye ibyatumye kibuzwa
kugenda;
(c) kitakoreshejwe hakurikijwe ibyasabwe
mu isuzuma rya tekiniki cyakorewe;
(d) cyateje impanuka yo mu muhanda
yapfiriyemo umuntu;
(e) kitanditswe mu mazina y’uwakiguze
cyangwa uwagihawe mu gihe
giteganywa n’itegeko;
(f) uhanishijwe ihazabu yo mu rwego
rw’ubutegetsi kubera ikosa
riteganyijwe muri iri tegeko atubahirije
igihe cyo kwishyura;
(g) cyangwa ku mpamvu z’iperereza
ry’ibanze, mu gihe umuyobozi wacyo
apimwe agasangwamo igipimo cya
arukoro mu maraso gisumba
igiteganywa n’itegeko.

articles.heading: Igihe ntarengwa cyo gufunga ikinyabiziga Igihe ntarengwa cyo gufunga ikinyabiziga ni amezi atatu abarwa uhereye ku munsi gufunga
articles.text:
ikinyabiziga byemerejweho n’umuyobozi
ubifitiye ububasha.

articles.heading: Imicungire y’ikinyabiziga gifunzwe (1) Ikinyabiziga gifunzwe gishyirwa ahantu habugenewe, nyiracyo akishyura
articles.text:
amafaranga ajyanye n’iryo fungwa.
(2) Iyo igihe kivugwa mu ngingo ya 19
kirangiye nyir’ikinyabiziga cyangwa
umuhagarariye wemewe n’amategeko
adakuye ikinyabiziga aho gifungiwe,
kigurishwa mu cyamunara hubahirijwe
igenagaciro rikozwe n’umugenagaciro
wemewe n’amategeko cyangwa
kigashyikirizwa ikigo cyemerewe
gutandukanya ibice bikigize,
kubivugurura no kubivanamo ibyangiza
ibidukikije.
(3) Mu gihe ikinyabiziga gifunzwe, nyiracyo
yemererwa, iyo abisabye, kukigurishiriza
hubahirijwe igenagaciro rikozwe
n’umugenagaciro wemewe n’amategeko.
(4) Iteka rya Minisitiri rigena ku buryo
burambuye ibijyanye n’imicungire
y’ikinyabiziga gifunzwe, uburyo bwo
kukigurishiriza, kukigurisha mu
cyamunara n’uko gutandukanya ibice
bikigize, kubivugurura no kubivanamo
ibyangiza ibidukikije bikorwa. Rigena
kandi imiterere, imitunganyirize
n’imikoreshereze by’ahantu hashyirwa
ikinyabiziga gifunzwe, amafaranga
agitangwaho, uko abarwa n’uko
yishyurwa.

articles.heading: Gukuraho icyemezo cyo gufunga ikinyabiziga (1) Umuyobozi ubifitiye ububasha akuraho icyemezo cyo gufunga ikinyabiziga
articles.text:
abyibwirije cyangwa abisabwe na
nyiracyo cyangwa umuhagarariye
wemewe n’amategeko, amaze
kugaragaza ko icyatumye ikinyabiziga
gifungwa kivuyeho kandi yishyuye
amafaranga ajyanye n’ifungwa ryacyo,
iyo ari ngombwa.
(2) Icyemezo cyo gufunga ikinyabiziga
gishobora kandi gukurwaho n’urukiko
rubifitiye ububasha, rubisabwe na
nyiracyo cyangwa umuhagarariye
wemewe n’amategeko.
(3) Ikirego gisaba ikurwaho ry’icyemezo
cyo gufunga ikinyabiziga gitangwa mu
buryo bw’ikirego cyihutirwa.

articles.heading: Imicungire y’amafaranga avuye mu igurishwa ry’ikinyabiziga cyafunzwe (1) Amafaranga avuye mu igurisha rikozwe
articles.text:
na nyir’ikinyabiziga cyafunzwe
cyangwa muri cyamunara yacyo ni yo
yonyine akoreshwa hishyurwa
ibyakozwe kubera iryo fungwa
n’imyenda ikibarwaho yerekeye
amakosa yo kutubahiriza ikoreshwa
ry’umuhanda.
(2) Amafaranga avuye mu igurisha rikozwe
na nyir’ikinyabiziga cyafunzwe
cyangwa mu igurisha ryacyo mu
cyamunara ashyirwa mu isanduku ya
Leta hagamijwe kubanza kwishyura
ibyakozwe kubera ifungwa ryacyo
n’imyenda yerekeye amakosa yo
kutubahiriza ikoreshwa ry’umuhanda,
asigaye agahabwa nyiracyo cyangwa
umuhagarariye wemewe n’amategeko.
(3) Iyo ikinyabiziga kigurishijwe mu
cyamunara, uwakigurishije abimenyesha
nyiracyo cyangwa umuhagarariye
wemewe n’amategeko mu gihe
cy’iminsi itanu ibarwa uhereye ku munsi
cyamunara yabereyeho.
UMUTWE WA III: IBYEREKEYE
UMUYOBOZI W’IKINYABIZIGA

articles.heading: Kugira uruhushya rwo gutwara ikinyabiziga n’uburyo bwo kurutanga (1) Umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga utwaye
articles.text:
ikinyabiziga kigendeshwa na moteri mu
muhanda agomba kugira uruhushya rwo
kugitwara.
(2) Urwego rufite kurinda umutekano wo mu
muhanda mu nshingano ni rwo rukoresha
ibizamini by’impushya zo gutwara
ibinyabiziga bigendeshwa na moteri
rukanazitanga.
(3) Iteka rya Minisitiri rigena uburyo
ikizamini cy’uruhushya rwo gutwara
ikinyabiziga kigendeshwa na moteri
gikorwa, imiterere y’uruhushya rwo
gutwara ikinyabiziga n’uburyo rutangwa.

articles.heading: Kwigisha gutwara ikinyabiziga (1) Kwigisha gutwara ikinyabiziga bikorwa n’umuntu ufite ishuri ryo kwigisha
articles.text:
gutwara ikinyabiziga kandi wabiherewe
icyemezo.
(2) Urwego rufite kurinda umutekano wo mu
muhanda mu nshingano ni rwo rureberera
rukanagenzura amashuri yigisha gutwara
ibinyabiziga.
(3) Iteka rya Minisitiri rigena ibishingirwaho
mu kwemerera umuntu gushinga ishuri
ryigisha gutwara ibinyabiziga,
imitunganyirize n’imikorere by’ishuri
ryigisha gutwara ibinyabiziga.

articles.heading: Ishyirwaho ry’uburyo koranabuhanga bwifashishwa mu gukurikirana imyitwarire y’umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga kigendeshwa na moteri
articles.text:
hakoreshejwe amanota y’imyitwarire
(1) Hashyizweho uburyo koranabuhanga
bwo gukurikirana imyitwarire
y’umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga ufite
uruhushya rwo gutwara ikinyabiziga
kigendeshwa na moteri hakoreshejwe
amanota y’imyitwarire ku mikoreshereze
y’umuhanda.
(2) Urwego rufite kurinda umutekano wo mu
muhanda mu nshingano rukurikirana
imyitwarire ku mikoreshereze
y’umuhanda, y’umuyobozi
w’ikinyabiziga kigendeshwa na moteri
ufite uruhushya rwo gutwara
ikinyabiziga, hakoreshejwe amanota
y’imyitwarire ku mikoreshereze
y’umuhanda.
(3) Iteka rya Minisitiri rigena uburyo bwo
kubara amanota y’imyitwarire ku
mikoreshereze y’umuhanda y’umuyobozi
w’ikinyabiziga kigendeshwa na moteri
ufite uruhushya rwo gutwara
ikinyabiziga.

articles.heading: Kutemererwa gukora ikizamini cy’uruhushya rwo gutwara ikinyabiziga cyangwa kuruhagarika by’agateganyo ku mpamvu z’uburwayi
articles.text:
(1) Urwego rufite kurinda umutekano wo mu
muhanda mu nshingano rushobora
kutemerera umuntu gukora ikizamini
cy’uruhushya rwo gutwara ikinyabiziga
cyangwa kuruhagarika by’agateganyo iyo
afite –
(a) kutabona guhagije kutakosowe
n’indorerwamo zabugenewe;
(b) kutumva cyangwa kumva buhoro
bikabije kandi ku matwi yombi;
(c) indwara y’umubiri ibuza ku buryo
bukabije ingingo z’umubiri kuyega
neza;
(d) cyangwa uburwayi buhungabanya
imikorere y’ubwonko.
(2) Urwego rufite kurinda umutekano wo mu
muhanda mu nshingano ruhagarika
by’agateganyo uruhushya rwo gutwara
ikinyabiziga rushingiye kuri raporo ya
muganga wemewe na Leta.
(3) Iyo umuntu wari ufite uburwayi buvugwa
mu gika cya (1) agaragaje icyemezo cya
muganga wemewe na Leta kigaragaza ko
uburwayi bwe bwakize cyangwa
bwakosowe, ahabwa uburenganzira bwo
gukora ikizamini cy’uruhushya rwo
gutwara ikinyabiziga cyangwa
akarusubizwa, iyo rwahagaritswe
by’agateganyo.
(4) Iteka rya Minisitiri rigena –
(a) uburyo bwo kutemerera umuntu
gukora ikizamini cy’uruhushya rwo
gutwara ikinyabiziga kubera impamvu
z’uburwayi;
(b) uburyo bwo guhagarika
by’agateganyo uruhushya rwo gutwara
ikinyabiziga kubera impamvu
z’uburwayi;
(c) n’ibipimo by’indwara zivugwa mu
gika cya (1) bishingirwaho kugira ngo
umuntu ntiyemererwe gukora
ikizamini cy’uruhushya rwo gutwara
ikinyabiziga cyangwa uruhushya rwe
ruhagarikwe by’agateganyo.
(5) Umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga ufite
uruhushya rwo gutwara ikinyabiziga
rwahagaritswe by’agateganyo
hakurikijwe ibiteganywa n’iyi ngingo,
ntiyemerewe gutwara ikinyabiziga igihe
cyose atararusubizwa.

articles.heading: Guhagarika by’agateganyo uruhushya rwo gutwara ikinyabiziga kubera imyitwarire y’umuyobozi wacyo ku
articles.text:
mikoreshereze y’umuhanda
(1) Urwego rufite kurinda umutekano wo
mu muhanda mu nshingano rushobora
guhagarika by’agateganyo uruhushya
rwo gutwara ikinyabiziga kubera
imyitwarire y’umuyobozi wacyo ku
mikoreshereze y’umuhanda.
(2) Umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga
wahagarikiwe by’agateganyo uruhushya
rwo gutwara ikinyabiziga kubera
imyitwarire y’umuyobozi wacyo ku
mikoreshereze y’umuhanda
ntiyemerewe gutwara ikinyabiziga mu
Rwanda n’iyo yaba afite uruhushya rwo
gutwara ikinyabiziga rwo mu kindi
gihugu.
(3) Iyo igihe cyo guhagarika by’agateganyo
uruhushya rwo gutwara ikinyabiziga
kubera imyitwarire y’umuyobozi wacyo
ku mikoreshereze y’umuhanda
kirangiye, rwongera gukoreshwa.
(4) Iteka rya Minisitiri rigena
ibishingirwaho mu guhagarika
by’agateganyo uruhushya rwo gutwara
ikinyabiziga kubera imyitwarire
y’umuyobozi wacyo ku mikoreshereze
y’umuhanda n’igihe bimara.

articles.heading: Gutesha agaciro uruhushya rwo gutwara ikinyabiziga (1) Gutesha agaciro uruhushya rwo gutwara
articles.text:
ikinyabiziga bikorwa n’urukiko
rubifitiye ububasha, bisabwe n’urwego
rufite kurinda umutekano wo mu
muhanda mu nshingano.
(2) Iyo uruhushya rwateshejwe agaciro
nyirarwo ntiyemerewe kongera gukora
ikizamini cy’uruhushya rwo gutwara
ikinyabiziga mbere y’amezi 12 abarwa
uhereye ku munsi urukiko rubifitiye
ububasha rwafatiye icyemezo cyo
kurutesha agaciro.
(3) Iteka rya Minisitiri rigena ibyo urukiko
rubifitiye ububasha rushingiraho mu
gutesha agaciro uruhushya rwo gutwara
ikinyabiziga.
UMUTWE WA IV: IBYEREKEYE
IKINYABIZIGA KIGENDESHWA NA
MOTERI

articles.heading: Ikinyabiziga kigendeshwa na moteri cyemerewe gukoresha umuhanda mu Rwanda (1) Ikinyabiziga kigendeshwa na moteri
articles.text:
cyemerewe gukoresha umuhanda mu
Rwanda ni icyanditswe mu Rwanda kandi
gifite ibikiranga n’icyanditswe mu kindi
gihugu kandi gifite ibikiranga byatanzwe
n’igihugu cyandikiwemo hakurikijwe
amategeko abigenga.
(2) Imodoka yandikwa mu Rwanda ni ifite
icyuma kiyobora ku ruhande rw’ibumoso
uretse –
(a) imodoka yakorewe abafite
ubumuga;
(b) ikamyo y’ubwikorezi ifite
ubushobozi bwo kwikorera nibura
toni 20;
(c) bisi itwara abagenzi ku buryo
bwambukiranya imipaka;
(d) imodoka yihariye ikoreshwa mu
mirimo y’ubuhinzi n’ubworozi, iyo
kubaka imihanda, iy’ubwubatsi,
iyo mu nganda n’iyo gupakira no
gupakurura;
(e) imodoka yahariwe ba
mukerarugendo basura u Rwanda,
iyambukiranya imipaka cyangwa
ihatemberera ku mpamvu iyo ari
yo yose;
(f) n’indi modoka yabiherwa
uburenganzira na Minisitiri.
(3) Imodoka yanditswe mu kindi gihugu, ifite
ibiyiranga byatanzwe n’igihugu
yanditswemo, ifite icyuma kiyobora ku
ruhande rw’iburyo ishobora gukoresha
umuhanda w’u Rwanda mu gihe kitarenze
amezi atatu abarwa uhereye ku munsi
yinjiriye mu Rwanda. Minisitiri ashobora
kongera icyo gihe, iyo abisabwe mu
nyandiko na nyirayo cyangwa
umuhagarariye wemewe n’amategeko.
(4) Iteka rya Minisitiri rigena ibyiciro
ibinyabiziga bigendeshwa na moteri
byandikwamo hakurikijwe ba nyirabyo.
Rigena kandi ibibiranga n’iyandikwa
ryabyo.

articles.heading: Ihererekanya ry’ikinyabiziga kigendeshwa na moteri (1) Nyir’ikinyabiziga kigendeshwa na moteri akora ihererekanya
articles.text:
ry’ikinyabiziga yagurishije cyangwa
yatanze.
(2) Urwego rufite iyandikwa
ry’ibinyabiziga bigendeshwa na moteri
mu nshingano rubika amakuru
yerekeye iyandikwa n’ihererekanya
by’ikinyabiziga kigendeshwa na
moteri mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga,
rugashyiraho n’uburyo uyakeneye
ayageraho ku buryo bumworoheye
hakurikijwe amategeko abigenga.
(3) Iteka rya Minisitiri rigena uburyo
ihererekanya ry’ikinyabiziga
kigendeshwa na moteri rikorwa.

articles.heading: Isuzuma rya tekiniki ry’ikinyabiziga kigendeshwa na moteri (1) Ikinyabiziga kigendeshwa na moteri
articles.text:
kigendera mu muhanda iyo cyakorewe
isuzuma rya tekiniki n’ikigo cyabiherewe
uburenganzira kandi icyo kigo
kikabitangira icyemezo cy’isuzumwa.
(2) Iteka rya Minisitiri rigena –
(a) ibyo ikigo gisabwa kugira ngo
cyemererwe gukora isuzuma rya
tekiniki ry’ikinyabiziga kigendeshwa
na moteri;
(b) igihe ntarengwa cyo gukora isuzuma
rya tekiniki ry’ikinyabiziga
kigendeshwa na moteri;
(c) ibishingirwaho kugira ngo
ikinyabiziga kigendeshwa na moteri
cyemererwe kugendera mu muhanda
kitarakorewe isuzuma rya tekiniki
cyangwa kitarahawe icyemezo
cy’isuzuma rya tekiniki;
(d) imitunganyirize y’isuzuma rya
tekiniki ry’ikinyabiziga kigendeshwa
na moteri;
(e) n’amafaranga yishyurwa ku isuzuma
rya tekiniki ry’ikinyabiziga
kigendeshwa na moteri.
(3) Iyo ikinyabiziga kigendeshwa na moteri
gikorewe isuzuma rya tekiniki
rikagaragaza ko gifite ibibazo bya
tekiniki bidashobora gukemurwa
cyamburwa uburenganzira bwo
kugendera mu muhanda.

articles.heading: Kwambura ikinyabiziga kigendeshwa na moteri uburenganzira bwo kugendera mu muhanda (1) Ikinyabiziga kigendeshwa na moteri
articles.text:
kibangamiye ikoreshwa ry’umuhanda
kubera inenge idashobora gukosorwa
gifite cyangwa igishaje ku buryo
kitakoreshwa, cyamburwa uburenganzira
bwo kugendera mu muhanda mu Rwanda
hakurikijwe ibiteganywa n’amategeko.
(2) Iyo ikinyabiziga kigendeshwa na moteri
cyambuwe uburenganzira bwo kugendera
mu muhanda, nyiracyo asubiza ibirango
byacyo mu kigo cyabitanze, kikajyanwa
mu kigo cyemerewe gutandukanya ibice
bikigize, kubivugurura no kubivanamo
ibyangiza ibidukikije.
(3) Iteka rya Minisitiri rigena ibyo ikigo
cyemerewe gutandukanya ibice bigize
ikinyabiziga, kubivugurura no
kubivanamo ibyangiza ibidukikije kiba
cyujuje kugira ngo cyemererwe gukora.
UMUTWE WA V: AMAKOSA, IBYAHA
N’IBIHANO N’UBURYO BWO
KUBIKURIKIRANA
Icyiciro cya mbere: Amakosa n’ibihano byo
mu rwego rw’ubutegetsi n’uburyo bwo
kubikurikirana

articles.heading: Kutubahiriza amategeko y’ikoreshwa ry’umuhanda (1) Ukoresha umuhanda utubahiriza amategeko yerekeye ikoreshwa ryawo,
articles.text:
aba akoze ikosa ryo mu rwego
rw’ubutegetsi.
(2) Iteka rya Minisitiri rigena urutonde
rw’amakosa yo mu rwego
rw’ubutegetsi yerekeye kutubahiriza
amategeko y’ikoreshwa ry’umuhanda,
ihazabu yo mu rwego rw’ubutegetsi
ijyanye na yo n’amanota y’imyitwarire
akurwa ku ukoze iryo kosa.

articles.heading: Igihe ntarengwa cyo kwishyura ihazabu yo mu rwego rw’ubutegetsi (1) Uhanishijwe ihazabu yo mu rwego
articles.text:
rw’ubutegetsi kubera kutubahiriza
amategeko y’ikoreshwa ry’umuhanda
yishyura ihazabu mu gihe kitarenze
iminsi 30 ibarwa uhereye ku munsi
aboneyeho ubutumwa bw’urwego
rushinzwe kurinda umutekano wo mu
muhanda bumumenyesha ikosa.
(2) Iyo igihe kivugwa mu gika cya (1)
kirangiye uwahanishijwe ihazabu yo mu
rwego rw’ubutegetsi kubera kutubahiriza
amategeko y’ikoreshwa ry’umuhanda
atarishyura, igihano cy’ihazabu
cyiyongeraho 30% by’ihazabu yari yaciwe,
yishyurwa bitarenze iminsi 30 ibarwa
uhereye ku munsi aboneyeho ubutumwa
bw’urwego rushinzwe kurinda umutekano
wo mu muhanda bumumenyesha ihazabu
y’inyongera.
(3) Iyo bigaragaye ko uwakoze ikosa yagize
uruhare mu gutuma ubutumwa buvugwa
mu gika cya (1) n’icya (2) butamugeraho,
bifatwa ko yabubonye ku munsi urwego
rushinzwe kurinda umutekano wo mu
muhanda rwabwoherereje.
(4) Iyo uwakoze ikosa atubahirije
ibiteganywa mu gika cya (1) n’icya (2),
ikinyabiziga cyakoreshejwe mu gukora
ikosa kirafatwa kigafungwa,
hagakurikizwa ibiteganywa n’ingingo ya
18 (f).

articles.heading: Ihanwa ry’amakosa ahungabanya umutekano wo mu muhanda (1) Ikosa rihungabanya umutekano wo mu
articles.text:
muhanda rihanwa n’umugenzacyaha
cyangwa umukozi ubifitiye ububasha.
(2) Umugenzacyaha cyangwa umukozi
ubifitiye ububasha aha umuyobozi
w’ikinyabiziga ukoze ikosa
rihungabanya umutekano wo mu
muhanda inyandiko koranabuhanga
imugaragariza ikosa yakoze n’igihano
yahawe.
(3) Urwego rufite kurinda umutekano wo
mu muhanda mu nshingano rugena
imiterere y’inyandiko koranabuhanga
ivugwa mu gika cya (2), amakosa
n’ibihano byayo.

articles.heading: Gutakambira icyemezo cy’umugenzacyaha cyangwa umukozi ubifitiye ububasha n’ubujurire (1) Umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga, utemeye
articles.text:
ikosa yahaniwe ashobora gutakambira
ubuyobozi bw’Urwego rushinzwe
kurinda umutekano wo mu muhanda
bumwegereye akoresheje inyandiko
cyangwa ubundi buryo bwose
bumworoheye mu gihe cy’iminsi itatu
y’akazi ibarwa uhereye ku munsi
yamenyesherejweho ikosa. Gutakamba
bishobora gukorwa kandi na
nyir’ikinyabiziga cyangwa
umuhagarariye wemewe n’amategeko.
(2) Umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga, nyiracyo
cyangwa umuhagarariye wemewe
n’amategeko watakambye asubizwa kuri
iryo takamba mu nyandiko mu gihe
cy’iminsi itatu y’akazi, ibarwa uhereye ku
munsi yatakambiyeho.
(3) Iyo umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga, nyiracyo
cyangwa umuhagarariye wemewe
n’amategeko watakambye atanyuzwe
n’igisubizo yahawe, ajuririra urwego
rwisumbuye ku rwo yatakambiye
akoresheje inyandiko cyangwa ubundi
buryo bwose bumworoheye mu gihe
cy’iminsi itatu y’akazi, ibarwa uhereye ku
munsi yaboneyeho igisubizo ku
itakamba. Urwego rwajuririwe rusubiza
mu nyandiko mu gihe cy’iminsi itatu
y’akazi, ibarwa uhereye ku munsi
rwakiriyeho ubujurire.
(4) Iyo umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga, nyiracyo
cyangwa umuhagarariye wemewe
n’amategeko watakambye adasubijwe mu
gihe giteganywa muri iyi ngingo ku
itakamba rivugwa mu gika cya (1)
cyangwa ku bujurire buvugwa mu gika
cya (3), bifatwa nkaho gutakamba kwe
cyangwa kujurira kwe gufite ishingiro,
agahanagurwaho ikosa yari yahaniwe
ryatumye atakamba cyangwa ajurira.
(5) Iyo umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga, nyiracyo
cyangwa umuhagarariye wemewe
n’amategeko wajuriye atishimiye
igisubizo yahawe n’urwego yajuririye,
ashobora gutanga ikirego mu rukiko
rubifitiye ububasha mu gihe cy’iminsi 30
ibarwa uhereye ku munsi yaherewe
igisubizo ku bujurire.
Icyiciro cya 2: Kugenza ibyaha no kubihana

articles.heading: Gutwara ikinyabiziga warengeje igipimo ntarengwa cya arukoro mu maraso (1) Umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga utwara
articles.text:
ikinyabiziga yarengeje igipimo
ntarengwa cya arukoro mu maraso aba
akoze icyaha. Iyo abihamijwe n’urukiko
ahanwa ku buryo bukurikira:
(a) ihazabu itari munsi ya FRW 100.000
ariko itarenze FRW 400.000
n’igifungo kitari munsi y’amezi 3
ariko kitarenze amezi 6, iyo atwaye
ikinyabiziga –
(i) gitwara abantu mu buryo bwa
rusange;
(ii) gitwara abanyeshuri;
(iii) gitwarira abakozi hamwe;
(iv) gitwara ba mukerarugendo;
(v) gitwara imizigo irengeje toni 3,5;
(vi) cyangwa ikindi kinyabiziga
kitavugwa muri aka gaka agamije
kwinjiza amafaranga;
(b) ihazabu itari munsi ya FRW 150 000
ariko itarenze FRW 300 000
n’igifungo kitarengeje iminsi 10
cyangwa kimwe muri ibyo bihano,
ku muyobozi w’ikinyabiziga
utavugwa mu gika cya (1)(a).
(2) Umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga utavugwa
mu gika cya (1)(a) ufite igipimo cya
arukoro mu maraso gikubye nibura
inshuro ebyiri z’igipimo ntarengwa,
ahanishwa ihazabu itari munsi ya FRW
200.000 ariko itarenze FRW 500.000
n’igifungo kitari munsi y’amezi 3 ariko
kitarengeje amezi 6 cyangwa kimwe
muri ibyo bihano.
(3) Iyo umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga yongeye
gukora icyaha giteganywa n’iyi ngingo
mu gihe kitarengeje umwaka umwe
ubarwa uhereye igihe yahamirijwe
icyaha n’urukiko mu rubanza rwabaye
ndakuka, ahanishwa igihano ntarengwa
giteganyijwe n’iyi ngingo kandi icyo
gihano gishobora kongerwa kugeza ku
nshuro ebyiri zacyo.

articles.heading: Kwanga gupimwa arukoro mu maraso (1) Umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga wanga gupimwa arukoro mu maraso, aba akoze
articles.text:
icyaha. Iyo abihamijwe n’urukiko,
ahanwa ku buryo bukurikira:
(a) ihazabu itari munsi ya FRW 300.000
ariko itarenze FRW 600.000
n’igifungo kitari munsi y’amezi 3 ariko
kitarenze amezi 6, iyo atwaye
ikinyabiziga –
(i) gitwara abantu mu buryo bwa
rusange;
(ii) gitwara abanyeshuri;
(iii) gitwarira abakozi hamwe;
(iv) gitwara ba mukerarugendo;
(v) gitwara imizigo irengeje toni 3,5;
(vi) cyangwa ikindi kinyabiziga
kitavugwa muri aka gaka agamije
kwinjiza amafaranga;
(b) ihazabu itari munsi ya FRW 400.000
ariko itarenze FRW 600.000
n’igifungo kitarengeje iminsi 10
cyangwa kimwe muri ibyo bihano, ku
muyobozi w’ikinyabiziga utavugwa
mu gika cya (1)(a).
(2) Iyo umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga yongeye
gukora icyaha giteganywa n’iyi ngingo
mu gihe kitarengeje umwaka umwe
ubarwa uhereye igihe yakoreye icyaha
kivugwa muri iyi ngingo ku nshuro ya
mbere, ahanishwa igihano ntarengwa
giteganyijwe n’iyi ngingo kandi icyo
gihano gishobora kongerwa kugeza ku
nshuro ebyiri zacyo.

articles.heading: Kwanga guhagarara ubitegetswe n’umugenzacyaha cyangwa umukozi ubifitiye ububasha Umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga uhagaritswe
articles.text:
n’umugenzacyaha cyangwa umukozi ubifitiye
ububasha akanga guhagarara, aba akoze
icyaha. Iyo abihamijwe n’urukiko ahanishwa
ihazabu itari munsi ya FRW 400.000 ariko
itarenze FRW 700.000 n’igifungo kitari munsi
y’amezi 3 ariko kitarengeje amezi 6.

articles.heading: Gutwara ikinyabiziga nta ruhushya rwo kugitwara (1) Umuyobozi w’ikinyabiziga kigendeshwa na moteri ugitwara
articles.text:
atagira uruhushya rwo kugitwara aba
akoze icyaha.
(2) Iyo abihamijwe n’urukiko, ahanishwa
ihazabu itari munsi ya FRW 100.000
ariko itarenze FRW 200.000
n’igifungo kitari munsi y’iminsi 15
ariko kitarenze iminsi 30 cyangwa
kimwe muri ibyo bihano.

articles.heading: Uburyo bwo kugenza ibyaha bihungabanya umutekano wo mu muhanda (1) Ubugenzacyaha ku byaha bihungabanya
articles.text:
umutekano wo mu muhanda bukorwa
n’umugenzacyaha.
(2) Mu kugenza ibyaha bihungabanya
umutekano wo mu muhanda,
umugenzacyaha akora dosiye
akayishyikiriza ubushinjacyaha mu gihe
giteganywa n’itegeko ryerekeye
imiburanishirize y’imanza
z’inshinjabyaha. Mu gihe akora iyo
nshingano, umugenzacyaha ayoborwa
kandi akagenzurwa n’umukuriye mu
kazi.
UMUTWE WA VI: INGINGO ZISOZA

articles.heading: Ibireba ihererekanya ry’ikinyabiziga kigendeshwa na moteri ritakozwe Umuntu wagurishije cyangwa watanze
articles.text:
ikinyabiziga kigendeshwa na moteri mbere
y’uko iri tegeko ritangira gukurikizwa akaba
atarakoze ihererekanya ahawe igihe kitarenze
amezi 12 abarwa uhereye ku munsi iri tegeko
ritangarijweho mu Igazeti ya Leta ya
Repubulika y’u Rwanda kugira ngo abe
yakoze ihererekanya.
